name: Dynos Audit
description: Description: Spec-driven audit enforcement for AI coding agents. Intercepts every phase transition with a mandatory audit loop. It builds a requirement ledger from your spec, audits the artifact, identifies gaps, delegates fixes, and re-audits until every requirement is provably done with evidence. Never accepts "mostly complete." Requires Superpowers.
longDescription:
Ships **21 skills** and **37 agents**.

- **Skills** (21): `audit` (Run checkpoint audit, repair any findings, then reach DONE — all in one shot), `calibration` (Internal dynos-work skill), `dashboard` (Internal dynos-work skill), `dry-run` (Internal dynos-work skill), `execute` (Execute the approved plan), `execution` (Internal dynos-work executor skill group), `global` (Internal dynos-work skill), `init` (Internal dynos-work skill), and 13 more
- **Agents** (37): `accessibility-auditor` (Internal dynos-work agent), `api-contract-auditor` (Internal dynos-work agent), `architecture-auditor` (Internal dynos-work agent), `backend-executor` (Internal dynos-work agent), `claude-md-auditor` (Internal dynos-work agent), `code-quality-auditor` (Internal dynos-work agent), `data-executor` (Internal dynos-work agent), `data-integrity-auditor` (Internal dynos-work agent), and 29 more

Installs with `claude plugin install dynos-audit@claude-community` from `HassamSheikh/dynos-audit`.
